It is all a matter of proper PR organization.
I still have not understood anything.
I am very afraid to meet with the president.
You are a simple working man of the people.
He really likes such simple people!
From fear sweat has already broken out on me.
And remember, this information is strictly classified.
Do not tell anyone, even your wife.
Right here our entire program is written.
The president really likes well-informed people.
You must answer the questions clearly.
Therefore come on, quickly pull yourself together!
Yes, I have already pulled myself together completely!
